scope: Independent finite read-only production assessment of the frozen gameplan; approval does not certify implementation or runtime readiness.
findings: Ordered balancing of pure static same-operator AND/OR is a sufficient narrowly scoped remedy for the stated 167-operand flattening failure. No Boolean identity, permutation, duplication or cross-operator rewrite is authorized.

The Lean model preserves arbitrary atom identities and their exact sequence, and proves Boolean semantics. Its leaves have fixed two-node weight for numerical witnesses. It does not prove weighted adapter construction, Alloy parser correspondence, source maps, scoped identity, or runtime stack safety; the spec and inventory explicitly retain these trust boundaries.

The 16 registered amendment theorem names match the source declarations inspected. accepted_public_limits_preserved projects existing guarded acceptance obligations rather than claiming a new adapter refinement. The prior 251 claims remain binding; 267-claim verification remains a separate clean-build gate.

Public 512-node/depth-32 validation remains mandatory for accepted BLOCK and final supported SOURCE. The independent transient 512-node/depth-512 cap cannot authorize persistence or weaken ownership, typing, scope, multiplicity, command or map validation.

Current AlloyExpressionReader.list left-folds and ModuleEquivalence recursively flattens, demonstrating why proof acceptance alone cannot close the actual defect or stack-safety gate. Existing comparison resolves references via indexed names; implementation evidence must establish that the inherited unique-name and lexical-scope rules really induce the declared identity correspondence, rather than accepting accidental label equality.
Singleton parser lists are explicitly unchanged and zero-operand lists unsupported. The mathematical empty-tree identity and exhausted-fuel fallback are not production permissions.

Raw accepted receipts, historical content, stable IDs, trivia and maps remain immutable. SOURCE receives fresh checked IDs and only validated scalar-aligned occurrences; Boolean equivalence supplies no token attachment evidence.
residual_runtime_criteria: Before production associativity edits, obtain all six exact-hash approvals and two isolated clean Lean builds checking all 251 prior claims plus the exact 16 amendment claims.

Run the exact frozen 500-node/depth-10 fixture through the actual worker with Xss512k: BLOCK print/parse/compare and supported SOURCE must succeed with 167 ordered operand occurrences; verify raw accepted content, IDs and maps remain exact.

Exercise both operators, repeated identical-looking operands, weighted nested subtrees, ExprBinary/ExprList and NOOP boundaries, singleton/zero lists, and mixed operators. Reject swapped/deleted/duplicated operands and grouping across implication, iff or quantifier boundaries.

Validate nominal field owners/ranges, binder capture and escaping/shared IDs, ordered arguments, declaration/command options and established field order under the actual comparison bijection. Recheck Unicode, CRLF, comments, omitted unavailable spans and source-copy immutability.

Enforce limits before uncontrolled allocation/traversal, including public depth 33, node count 513 and transient depth over 512. Demonstrate safe bounded or iterative traversal under actual stack caps; stack overflow, timeout and worker errors must remain availability failures and cannot become TEXT_ONLY or acceptance.
Independently rerun original 500-node latency targets and inherited G2/G3, worker isolation, UI/accessibility and SQL proxy requirements. Finite formal review grants no commercial clearance.
